newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 25 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 25 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 25 issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--University of Alabama Board of Trustees $29 million of tax-exempt auxiliary revenue bonds and $10 million of taxable revenue bonds.
--San Francisco Airport $57 million revenue AMT bonds, $131 million of taxable revenue bonds and $61 million of AMT revenue bonds.
--Monticello Communtiy School District, Iowa, $4.4 million of GO school bonds.
--Polk County, Iowa, $10 million of GO bonds.
--Wicomico County, Md., $6.2 million of public improvement bonds.
--Kalamazoo County, Mich., $2.1 million GOs.
--Duluth ISD No. 709, Minn., $4.625 million refunding GOs.
--Vadnais Heights, Minn., $4.3 million and $1.1 million of GO tax increment bonds.
--Gulfport, Miss., $6 million of GO water and sewer bonds.
--Lafayette County, Miss., $5 million GO bonds.
--Statesville, N.C., $980,000 water and sewer bonds and $500,000 water bonds.
--Jackson Township, N.J., $12 million GOs.
--N.E. Monmouth Sewer Authority, N.J., $12.480 refunding revenue bonds.
--Oakland, N.J., $2.335 million improvement bonds.
--Bridgeport, Texas, $1.030 million tax and revenue bonds.
--Bryan, Texas, $2.5 million revenue bonds.
--Forest Cove MUD, Texas, $1.130 million waste water and san. sewer bonds.
--Kennewick, Wash., $5.9 million of GO bonds.
--Sun Prairie, Wis., $1.205 million GOs.
--Canon, Pa., $5 million school district bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
